title: Tiny, cute hourglass
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- soft glow behind hourglass -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='30' ry='36' fill='#1b2440'/>
  <!-- top wooden cap -->
  <rect x='30' y='12' width='40' height='9' rx='4' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <rect x='30' y='12' width='40' height='4' rx='2' fill='#e8b87a'/>
  <!-- bottom wooden cap -->
  <rect x='30' y='79' width='40' height='9' rx='4' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <rect x='30' y='79' width='40' height='4' rx='2' fill='#e8b87a'/>
  <!-- glass body -->
  <path d='M35 21 L65 21 L52 50 L65 79 L35 79 L48 50 Z' fill='#7fd4e8' opacity='0.28'/>
  <!-- glass edge highlights -->
  <path d='M35 21 L48 50 L35 79' fill='none' stroke='#a8e8f5' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M65 21 L52 50 L65 79' fill='none' stroke='#a8e8f5' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- top sand -->
  <path d='M38 23 L62 23 L52 46 Z' fill='#f7c948'/>
  <path d='M40 23 L60 23 L52 40 Z' fill='#ffe08a'/>
  <!-- falling sand stream -->
  <rect x='49' y='46' width='2.5' height='22' fill='#f7c948'/>
  <!-- bottom sand pile -->
  <path d='M40 78 L60 78 L52 62 Q50 60 48 62 Z' fill='#f7c948'/>
  <path d='M44 78 L56 78 L52 70 Z' fill='#ffe08a'/>
  <!-- cute face on glass: eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='48' r='2.6' fill='#2b1d4a'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='48' r='2.6' fill='#2b1d4a'/>
  <circle cx='44.9' cy='47.1' r='0.9' fill='#a8e8f5'/>
  <circle cx='56.9' cy='47.1' r='0.9' fill='#a8e8f5'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M46 53 Q50 56 54 53' fill='none' stroke='#2b1d4a' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='53' r='2.4' fill='#ff9ec4' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='53' r='2.4' fill='#ff9ec4' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
